IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, August 11, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is running hot with **$58.90/hr** base plus **$10 above scale** at Ermco's Meta Data Center in Lebanon on 5-10s Mon-Fri, 8s Saturday. Industrial Electric's stacked Eli Lilly jobs (K153, K196, Lebanon LP1) are new construction plays with rotating 7-10s and the 13-day rule in play. Heavy background checks across the board—these are pharmaceutical-grade gigs. Board's got 146 hands chasing 33 calls.

**LU-430 Racine, WI** is the wage leader here at **$62.51/hr**—Gerdes, Pieper, Staff Electric, and Kelso Burnett all pulling from the same Microsoft Mount Pleasant contract. All four contractors need WI inside JW or reciprocal cards with 2+ years verifiable. Long sleeves, safety-toe mandatory. Board's thin (76 hands, 11 calls), meaning you hit dispatch fast or you're next-out.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** stacks incentive pay sharp: **$44.80 base** plus **$100/day ND license premium** plus **$100–$150/day per diem** (non-taxed) for the Polaris Forge Data Center. Parsons Electric's running 57 calls across two shifts; Hunt Electric's got Grand Forks Air Base at 4-10s with Friday OT. 101 hands on the board—book depth matters here.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** offers **$40–$40.90/hr** across Inglett & Stubbs, Whitehead Electric, and Miller TN. Wellstar Paulding Hospital and QTS Fayette are the steady pulls. 305 hands chasing 56 calls means you're competing, but the board's deep and consistent.

**LU-379 Charlotte, NC** and **LU-520 Austin, TX** are data-center-fueled machines—Rosendin, Miller, and QTS contracts pulling JWs and CEs at **$3.50–$4.00 over scale** with 5-10s, 1-8 Saturdays, and some boot vouchers landing after 90 days.

**Data centers and mega-projects are swallowing hands across the midwest and southeast; if you're not chasing DC work in '26, you're chasing air.**

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Tuesday, August 11, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is the board's fat target right now—46 calls eating 140 hands with New River Electric Corp. running two separate pushes: 40 JL on 10-hour days (distro work, $125/night PD plus $125 bonus) and 9 more doing 4-10s across Southern Ohio. Capital Electric's cable splice crew in Johnstown (6 slots) wants OSHA 10 and splicing experience. This is volume work, and the board's moving bodies.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is where the real money lands—Parsons Electric's pouring 57 hands into the Polaris Forge Data Center at **$44.80/hr** base, but stack on **$100/day Mon-Fri incentive, $150 Sat/Sun, plus another $100 if you get your ND license**. Hunt Electric's got 10 more at Grand Forks Air Base (Real ID required). The catch: bids close 8/12 at 8am on the Fargo/Moorhead slots. This is organized incentive money.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA**—30 calls, Service Electric running 17 JL on that Social Circle GA Power energize job at $46.80/hr on an 11-on-3-off cycle. Inception Energy's 9 slots in Savannah run 5-10s and demand grid time. Groundman work exists if you're filling gaps.

**LU-175 Chattanooga, TN** has 14 calls stacked on data center and nuclear work: Adman's 25 Inside JL at DNN4 (day shift, Dalton), Lawson's 12 same site (hire-in Wed 9am), and Day & Zimmermann's 10 on Watts Bar Nuclear (TVA clearance required). These are long-duration holds.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** leads on scale at **$88.86 top**, but the real action's Veca's 22 slots at the META site for **$65.33** (prefab warehouse work, 5-8s currently running 6-day weeks), and Micron's 18 combined slots at **$45.33** base plus **$170/day PD** and **$20/hr travel pay** on a grinding 60/60/50 schedule. PLA work holds bodies.

Data center builds and utility transmission are where boards are clearing—574 of these 1,455 hands are chasing megaproject pay, not storm calls.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Tuesday, August 11, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running *hot* with 18 calls and 61 hands needed—the fat board right now. BCS Mechanical's got 15 JW Pipefitters and 13 JW Plumbers locked on the Sego Project (West Valley) running 4-10s with OT, started August 3rd. DSI's pushing 6 more JWs into QTS (Eagle Mountain) on a mixed 5-10s + Saturday schedule with a $10.00 bump. Apprentices eating too. This is a seasonal crush—book's moving.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** sits second-heaviest at 21 calls, 30 hands open, but the work's fragmented: Charter's got 4 Orbital Welders on Intel tool install at Ronler Acres (Hillsboro), PermaCold's running 3 commercial refrigeration techs in the metro, and Harder's hiring BIM Detailers. Intel's pulling skilled hands into semi-fab support work; that's where the West Coast money's shifting this quarter.

**LU-213 St John, NB** (10 calls, 37 hands) is all refinery and pulp-mill grind: Stuart Olson's got 13 F3/F4 welders testing into F6/F5 work at Irving Oil on night shift, CAM's running 10 JW Pipefitters days at Irving Pulp & Paper under industrial agreement. Maritime industrial scale, solid reliability.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** (9 calls, 31 hands) is the fab-shop combo welder grind: Graham's got Cenovus maintenance splitting 5 pipefitters and 5 combo welders, Gem's running a fab shop with 7 combo welders (will test), Ineos outage tie-in. Testing gates this board hard.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** is lean (1 call, 12 hands) but clean: Four Seasons towers, Henderson, JWs starting Thursday 7/30—OSHA 10/30 card mandatory.

Industrial outage season and semiconductor fab ramps are driving the load; refineries and data-center buildout won't cool until November.
